parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Briefly describe the day of a marriage (nikah).

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain teachings about marriage (nikah) between Muslims and those of other faiths
according to one school of jurisprudence (fiqh).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Discuss how Muslims living in different societies might apply these teachings today. Refer to
different points of view in your answer. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Give five scholars who presented opinions of jurisprudence (fiqh) in Islam.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the use of consensus (ijmaʿ) for Muslims as a source of Islamic law (shariah).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Discuss the importance of consensus (ijmaʿ) today. Refer to two different schools of
jurisprudence (fiqh) in your answer. 
Section B
Answer EITHER Question 3 OR Question 4.
EITHER

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how Sunni Imams are appointed.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Compare the importance of the Prophet’s family to Sunni and Shi’i Muslims with regard to
Imams. 
OR

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Compare the use of rationalism by the Mu’tazilah with one other Islamic school of thought
which you have studied.
